topic: fix a phone with a cracked screen
core_question: My phone screen is cracked, how do I fix it? (secondary: How do I get wifi into a room in my house that has a dead zone?)
answer_summary: Take the phone to a manufacturer/authorized repair shop (or a reputable third-party repair service) to have the cracked screen assembly replaced.; after the topic shift: Install a mesh wifi extender or satellite unit positioned between the router and the dead zone to rebroadcast the signal into that room.
persona: sarcastic; texting quickly with typos here and there
